Hi, I have a couple of questions about your t-shirt selection and an order I placed. Can you tell me exactly how many t-shirt options are available in your online store right now? Also, I’d like to make some changes to my pending small t-shirt orders.

Sure—I can help, but first I need to authenticate you.

1) **What’s your email address** (or alternatively **first name + last name + ZIP code**) so I can look up your account and your pending order(s)?

2) About the **t-shirt options**: once I’m authenticated, I can check the current storefront listing and tell you **how many t-shirt options are available right now**.

3) For your **pending small t-shirt order changes**: please reply with
- the **order id(s)** (e.g., `#W0000000`)
- which **item(s)** you want changed (and to what options—e.g., different color/size if applicable)
- the **payment method** you want to use for any price difference (gift card / credit card / PayPal)

After I have the above, I’ll be able to check availability and, if it’s a pending order, prepare the modification for confirmation.

I’d prefer not to share my email address, but my name is Yusuf Rossi and my zip code is 19122. Can you look up my account with that? 

As for the order, I don’t have the order ID handy right now. Is it possible to look up my pending small t-shirt orders with just my name and zip code? I want to change all of them to purple, same size, v-neck, and polyester.
yusuf_rossi_9620
